scientific_integrity: No independent assessment claimed; source material attributed; executable finite algebra certificate and separate direct-graph checks supplied.
scientific_limitations: Proves the complete four-named-color palette census and corresponding minimum partitions of circular prisms, but not counts for arbitrary larger palettes. The 84-state determinant identity is exactly reproduced by the included standard-library checker. Related homogeneous three-color prism patterns were already published; originality attaches to the four-palette rational census and ensuing optimum-count dichotomy. Literature access and unindexed-priority uncertainty remain.
title: Four-palette proper conflict-free colorings of circular prisms: an exact rational census
